seats.name: Target & Attribute Parity Reviewer
seats.responsibility: Verifies 1:1 semantic alignment of targets, deps, sources (including moving *_test.go files from GN go_library.sources into Bazel host_go_test/go_test srcs with embed), flags, complete migration of all convertible libraries (including reference/bitrot-prevention targets without # @bazel2gn:skip), 3-tier idiomatic Bazel visibility scoping (deferring to visibility_audit and find_rdeps per_target_recommended_visibility; never //visibility:public outside //build/bazel_sdk/...), that the change modifies only build-definition files (no source edits), shared lint config reuse: lint_config points at the defining rust_lint_config (no new alias/wrapper targets) and default lint dicts are loaded from the //build/config/rust/lints .bzl instead of copied, and GN dependency label and edge-kind parity against the base BUILD.gn (no GN-only wrapper swapped for the library it wraps, no dropped link-carrying deps, public config forwarding kept via path_overwrite or the package-local forwarding group).

seats.name: Dual-Build & Sentinel Reviewer
seats.responsibility: Verifies BAZEL2GN SENTINEL synchronization, rejects target-level # @bazel2gn:skip on convertible or reference libraries and rejects duplicate/unmigrated convertible targets above the sentinel in BUILD.gn, build-only change scope, lint_config label parity (same-named GN config() next to the Bazel rust_lint_config, no new alias + forwarding-config wrapper pairs), and that the Rust public_deps forwarding group is the only hand-written dependency-routing target allowed above the sentinel.
